	font-size: 15px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-zxnet-topic-echo a {
	position: relative;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
	padding-bottom: 2px;
}
.smn-zxnet-topic-echo a::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	height: 2px;
	background: var(--smn-accent);
	transform: scaleX(0);
	transform-origin: left center;
	transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}
.smn-zxnet-topic-echo a:hover {
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-zxnet-topic-echo a:hover::after {
	transform: scaleX(1);
}
.smn-zxnet-messages {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg {
	padding: 22px 0;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	animation: smn-fade-up 0.55s ease both;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg:first-child {
	padding-top: 0;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg:last-child {
	border-bottom: none;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.05s; }
.smn-zxnet-msg:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.smn-zxnet-msg:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.15s; }
.smn-zxnet-msg:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.smn-zxnet-msg:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.25s; }
.smn-zxnet-msg-meta {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 8px 12px;
	margin: 0 0 14px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-row {
	display: inline-flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 6px;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-label {
	font-size: 11px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.06em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: rgba(60, 55, 50, 0.55);
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-name {
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-sep {
	opacity: 0.45;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-date {
	margin-left: auto;
	font-weight: 400;
	color: rgba(60, 55, 50, 0.72);
	white-space: nowrap;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-body {
	font-family: var(--smn-mono);
	font-size: 14px;
	line-height: 1.45;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	white-space: pre-wrap;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	word-break: break-word;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-body p {
	margin: 0 0 0.7em;
	white-space: normal;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-body p:last-child {
	margin-bottom: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 820px) {
	.smn-zxnet-msg-meta {
		font-size: 13px;
	}
	.smn-zxnet-msg-date {
		margin-left: 0;
		width: 100%;
	}
	.smn-zxnet-msg-body {
		font-size: 13px;
	}
}

/* Books catalog */
.smn-books .smn-list-item:last-child {
	border-bottom: none;
}
.smn-book-card {
	display: block;
	overflow: hidden;
}
.smn-book-cover {
	float: left;
	margin: 0 18px 8px 0;
}
.smn-book-cover img {
	width: 96px;
	height: auto;
	aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
	object-fit: cover;
	background: var(--smn-paper-deep);
	border: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-book-subtitle {
	display: block;
	margin: 0 0 6px;
	font-family: var(--smn-serif);
	font-size: 16px;
	line-height: 1.4;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-book-meta {
	display: block;
	margin: 0 0 10px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 13px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-book-flags {
	display: inline-flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 6px 10px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 12px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-book-flag {
	white-space: nowrap;
}

@media (max-width: 820px) {
	.smn-book-cover {
		margin-right: 14px;
	}
	.smn-book-cover img {
		width: 72px;
	}
	.smn-book-subtitle {
		font-size: 15px;
	}
}

/* Single book page */
.smn-book-layout {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(140px, 220px) minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: 28px 36px;
	align-items: start;
}
.smn-book-covers {
	display: grid;
	gap: 16px;
}
.smn-book-cover-full {
	margin: 0;
}
.smn-book-cover-full img {
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	height: auto;
	background: var(--smn-paper-deep);
	border: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-book-title {
	margin: 0 0 8px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-weight: 700;
	font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
	line-height: 1.15;
	letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}
.smn-book-subtitle-lg {
	margin: 0 0 22px;
	font-family: var(--smn-serif);
	font-size: 18px;
	line-height: 1.4;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-book-facts {
	margin: 0 0 28px;
	padding: 0;
}
.smn-book-fact {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 140px minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: 8px 16px;
	padding: 8px 0;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 15px;
}
.smn-book-fact:last-child {
	border-bottom: none;
}
.smn-book-fact dt {
	margin: 0;
	font-size: 11px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.06em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: rgba(60, 55, 50, 0.55);
	padding-top: 3px;
}
.smn-book-fact dd {
	margin: 0;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-book-section-title {
	margin: 0 0 12px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-book-annotation {
	margin: 0 0 28px;
}
.smn-book-annotation-body {
	font-family: var(--smn-serif);
	font-size: 17px;
	line-height: 1.55;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-book-annotation-body p {
	margin: 0 0 0.8em;
}
.smn-book-annotation-body p:last-child {
	margin-bottom: 0;
}
.smn-book-files {
	margin: 0 0 28px;
}
.smn-book-file-list {
	list-style: none;
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
	display: grid;
	gap: 10px;
}
.smn-book-file {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 6px 16px;
	padding: 14px 16px;
	border: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
	text-decoration: none;
	color: inherit;
	transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
}
.smn-book-file:hover {
	border-color: var(--smn-accent);
	color: inherit;
}
.smn-book-file-name {
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-weight: 700;
	font-size: 15px;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-book-file-meta {
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 13px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-book .smn-press-toc {
	margin-top: 8px;
}

.smn-book-chapter-tags-label {
	margin-right: 4px;
}

.smn-book-chapter .smn-article-related.smn-press-toc {
	margin-top: 0;
}

/* Comments block (reuses guestbook form styles) */
.smn-comments {
	margin-top: 40px;
	padding-top: 28px;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-comments-heading {
	margin: 0 0 16px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 20px;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.25;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-comments-lead {
	margin: 0 0 14px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-comments-list-heading {
	margin: 8px 0 12px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 18px;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.25;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-comments .smn-guestbook-form {
	border-top: 0;
	padding-top: 0;
}
.smn-comments .smn-guestbook-msg:last-child {
	border-bottom: 0;
}
.smn-guestbook-form {
	margin: 0 0 36px;
	padding: 20px 0 24px;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	animation: smn-fade-up 0.55s ease both;
}
.smn-guestbook-error {
	margin: 0 0 16px;
	padding: 12px 14px;
	border-left: 3px solid var(--smn-accent);
	background: rgba(164, 30, 0, 0.06);
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-guestbook-fields {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 2fr 2fr 1fr;
	gap: 14px 18px;
	align-items: end;
}
.smn-guestbook-field {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 6px;
	margin: 0;
	min-width: 0;
}
.smn-guestbook-field--message {
	grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.smn-guestbook-label {
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 12px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-guestbook-req {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
	font-weight: 700;
}
.smn-guestbook-input,
.smn-guestbook-textarea {
	width: 100%;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	margin: 0;
	padding: 10px 12px;
	border: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	border-radius: 0;
	background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 15px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-guestbook-input:focus,
.smn-guestbook-textarea:focus {
	outline: none;
	border-color: var(--smn-accent);
	background-color: #fff;
}
.smn-guestbook-input--captcha {
	background-repeat: no-repeat;
	background-position: right 8px center;
	background-size: auto 28px;
	padding-right: 88px;
}
.smn-guestbook-input--captcha:focus {
	background-color: #fff;
	background-repeat: no-repeat;
	background-position: right 8px center;
	background-size: auto 28px;
}
.smn-guestbook-textarea {
	min-height: 110px;
	resize: vertical;
	line-height: 1.45;
	font-weight: 500;
}
.smn-guestbook-actions {
	margin-top: 16px;
}
.smn-guestbook-submit {
	appearance: none;
	border: 1px solid var(--smn-ink);
	background: var(--smn-ink);
	color: #fff;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.03em;
	padding: 10px 18px;
	cursor: pointer;
	transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}
.smn-guestbook-submit:hover {
	background: var(--smn-accent);
	border-color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-guestbook-list {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 0;
	margin: 0;
	animation: smn-fade-up 0.55s ease 0.06s both;
}
.smn-guestbook-msg {
	padding: 18px 0;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-guestbook-msg:first-child {
	padding-top: 4px;
}
.smn-guestbook-msg-meta {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 6px 16px;
	margin: 0 0 8px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 700;
}
.smn-guestbook-msg-name {
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-guestbook-msg.is-highlight .smn-guestbook-msg-name {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-guestbook-msg-date {
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-guestbook-msg-body {
	font-family: var(--smn-serif);
	font-size: 17px;
	line-height: 1.5;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	overflow-wrap: break-word;
	word-break: normal;
	hyphens: auto;
	-webkit-hyphens: auto;
}

/* Updates list */
.smn-updates {
	margin: 0;
	animation: smn-fade-up 0.55s ease 0.06s both;
}
.smn-updates-rule {
	height: 0;
	margin: 18px 0 14px;
	border: 0;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-updates-row {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 7.5rem minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: 10px 18px;
	align-items: start;
	padding: 6px 0;
}
.smn-updates-date {
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 13px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.02em;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
	line-height: 1.45;
	padding-top: 2px;
	min-height: 1.2em;
}
.smn-updates-body {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 4px;
	min-width: 0;
}
.smn-updates-press {
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 15px;
	font-weight: 700;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
	line-height: 1.35;
}
.smn-updates-press:hover {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-updates-article {
	font-family: var(--smn-serif);
	font-size: 17px;
	line-height: 1.4;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
	overflow-wrap: break-word;
}
.smn-updates-article:hover {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}

/* Categories */
.smn-cat-tree-wrap {
	margin: 8px 0 0;
	animation: smn-fade-up 0.55s ease 0.06s both;
}
.smn-cat-tree {
	list-style: none;
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
}
.smn-cat-tree--fake-root > .smn-cat-tree-item > .smn-cat-tree-label {
	display: inline-block;
	padding: 2px 0 6px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 17px;
	font-weight: 700;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	line-height: 1.4;
}
.smn-cat-tree-item > .smn-cat-tree-link {
	display: inline;
	vertical-align: baseline;
}
.smn-cat-tree-link {
	display: inline-block;
	padding: 2px 0;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 15px;
	font-weight: 400;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
	line-height: 1.4;
}
.smn-cat-tree-link--l0 {
	font-size: 17px;
	font-weight: 700;
	/* slight optical weight — no 800 face in Proxima Nova */
	text-shadow: 0.35px 0 0 currentColor, -0.35px 0 0 currentColor;
}
.smn-cat-tree-link--l1 {
	font-weight: 600;
}
.smn-cat-tree-link--l2,
.smn-cat-tree-link--l3,
.smn-cat-tree-link--l4,
.smn-cat-tree-link--l5 {
	font-weight: 400;
}
.smn-cat-tree .smn-cat-tree {
	margin: 4px 0 0 0.25rem;
	padding: 0;
}
.smn-cat-tree .smn-cat-tree > .smn-cat-tree-item {
	position: relative;
	padding: 3px 0 3px 1.2rem;
}
.smn-cat-tree .smn-cat-tree > .smn-cat-tree-item::before {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	top: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	border-left: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-cat-tree .smn-cat-tree > .smn-cat-tree-item::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	top: 0.95em;
	width: 1rem;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-cat-tree .smn-cat-tree > .smn-cat-tree-item:last-child::before {
	bottom: auto;
	height: 0.95em;
}
.smn-cat-tree-link:hover {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-cat-image {
	margin: 0 0 28px;
	max-width: 720px;
}
.smn-cat-image img {
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	height: auto;
	border: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	background: var(--smn-paper-deep);
}
.smn-cat-articles {
	margin: 0;
	animation: smn-fade-up 0.55s ease 0.06s both;
}
.smn-cat-articles-heading {
	margin: 0 0 16px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 15px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.03em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-cat-issue {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 6px 14px;
	margin: 4px 0 6px;
}
.smn-cat-issue-link {
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 15px;
	font-weight: 700;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
}
.smn-cat-issue-link:hover {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-cat-issue-date {
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 13px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-cat-article {
	padding: 3px 0 8px 1rem;
}
.smn-cat-article--titles-only {
	padding-left: 0;
}
.smn-cat-article a {
	font-family: var(--smn-serif);
	font-size: 17px;
	line-height: 1.4;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
	overflow-wrap: break-word;
}
.smn-cat-article a:hover {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}

@media (max-width: 820px) {
	.smn-book-layout {
		grid-template-columns: 1fr;
		gap: 22px;
	}
	.smn-book-covers {
		grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 180px));
	}
	.smn-book-fact {
		grid-template-columns: 1fr;
		gap: 4px;
	}
	.smn-guestbook-fields {
		grid-template-columns: 1fr;
	}
	.smn-updates-row {
		grid-template-columns: 5.5rem minmax(0, 1fr);
		gap: 8px 12px;
	}
	.smn-updates-date {
		font-size: 12px;
	}
	.smn-updates-article {
		font-size: 16px;
	}
	.smn-cat-tree .smn-cat-tree {
		margin-left: 0.1rem;
	}
	.smn-cat-tree .smn-cat-tree > .smn-cat-tree-item {
		padding-left: 1rem;
	}
	.smn-cat-article {
		padding-left: 0.75rem;
	}
	.smn-cat-article a {
		font-size: 16px;
	}
}

/* Publications map /ru/map */
.smn-map-tabs {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 6px 22px;
	margin: 0 0 20px;
	padding: 0;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 18px;
	font-weight: 600;
	letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.smn-map-tab {
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
.smn-map-tab-label {
	position: relative;
	padding-bottom: 4px;
}
.smn-map-tab-label::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	height: 2px;
	background: var(--smn-accent);
	transform: scaleX(0);
	transform-origin: left;
	transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}
a.smn-map-tab:hover {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
a.smn-map-tab:hover .smn-map-tab-label::after,
.smn-map-tab.is-active .smn-map-tab-label::after {
	transform: scaleX(1);
}
.smn-map-tab.is-active {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-map-tab .smn-filter-count {
	margin-left: 2px;
}
.smn-press-map {
	width: 100%;
	height: min(70vh, 640px);
	min-height: 360px;
	margin: 0;
	border: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	background: var(--smn-paper-deep);
}
.smn-map-popup {
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 13px;
	line-height: 1.4;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-map-popup a {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
	text-decoration: none;
}
.smn-map-popup a:hover {

<script>
(function () {
	function initSuggest(inputId, dropId) {
		var input = document.getElementById(inputId);
		var drop = document.getElementById(dropId);
		if (!input || !drop) return;
		var timer = null, sel = -1;

		function suggestLng() {
			var p = location.pathname || '';
			return (p === '/en' || p.indexOf('/en/') === 0 || p.indexOf('/eng/') === 0) ? 'eng' : 'ru';
		}

		function initGoButton() {
			var wrap = input.closest('.smn-search-wrap');
			if (!wrap || wrap.querySelector('.smn-search-go')) return;
			var btn = document.createElement('button');
			btn.type = 'submit';
			btn.className = 'smn-search-go';
			btn.textContent = suggestLng() === 'eng' ? 'detailed search' : 'подробный поиск';
			wrap.appendChild(btn);

			function syncGo() {
				var has = !!String(input.value || '').trim();
				btn.hidden = !has;
				wrap.classList.toggle('has-query', has);
			}

			input.addEventListener('input', syncGo);
			input.addEventListener('change', syncGo);
			input.addEventListener('keyup', syncGo);
			syncGo();
		}

		initGoButton();

		function sizeDrop() {
			var rect = drop.getBoundingClientRect();
			// When hidden, measure from the search wrap bottom.
			var top = rect.top;
			if (!top || drop.style.display === 'none') {
				var wrap = input.closest('.smn-search-wrap') || input;
				top = wrap.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
			}
			var room = Math.floor(window.innerHeight - top - 12);
			if (room < 120) room = 120;
			drop.style.maxHeight = room + 'px';
		}

		function hideDrop(clear) {
			drop.style.display = 'none';
			if (clear) drop.innerHTML = '';
		}

		function showDrop() {
			sizeDrop();
			drop.style.display = 'block';
			sizeDrop();
		}

		function dropItems() {
			return drop.querySelectorAll('.smn-suggest-row');
		}

		function setActiveItem(items, index) {
			for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
				items[i].classList.toggle('active', i === index);
			}
		}

		function itemLabel(item) {
			if (typeof item === 'string') return item;
			return (item && item.label) ? String(item.label) : '';
		}

		function applyItem(row) {
			var url = row.getAttribute('data-url') || '';
			var label = row.getAttribute('data-label') || row.textContent || '';
			hideDrop(true);
			if (url) {
				location.href = url;
				return;
			}
			input.value = label;
			var form = input.closest('form');
			if (form) form.submit();
		}

		function renderItems(data) {
			drop.innerHTML = '';
			sel = -1;
			if (!data || !data.length) {
				var empty = document.createElement('div');
				empty.className = 'smn-suggest-empty';
				empty.textContent = suggestLng() === 'eng'
					? 'Nothing found, try detailed search'
					: 'Ничего не найдено, попробуйте подробный поиск';
				drop.appendChild(empty);
				showDrop();
				return;
			}
			for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
				var item = data[i];
				var label = itemLabel(item);
				if (!label) continue;
				var row = document.createElement('div');
				row.className = 'smn-suggest-row';
				row.setAttribute('data-label', label);
				if (item && item.url) row.setAttribute('data-url', String(item.url));
				if (item && item.type) row.setAttribute('data-type', String(item.type));

				var main = document.createElement('div');
				main.className = 'smn-suggest-label';
				if (item && item.label_html) {
					main.innerHTML = String(item.label_html);
				} else {
					main.textContent = label;
				}
				row.appendChild(main);

				if (item && item.meta) {
					var meta = document.createElement('div');
					meta.className = 'smn-suggest-meta';
					meta.textContent = String(item.meta);
					row.appendChild(meta);
				}
				drop.appendChild(row);
			}
			if (!dropItems().length) {
				var emptyFallback = document.createElement('div');
				emptyFallback.className = 'smn-suggest-empty';
				emptyFallback.textContent = suggestLng() === 'eng'
					? 'Nothing found, try detailed search'
					: 'Ничего не найдено, попробуйте подробный поиск';
				drop.appendChild(emptyFallback);
				showDrop();
				return;
			}
			showDrop();
		}

		function blockSuggestContextMenu(e) {
			e.preventDefault();
			e.stopPropagation();
		}

		// Only block context menu on suggestion rows — not on the input
		// (so Inspect / DevTools via right-click still work).
		drop.addEventListener('contextmenu', blockSuggestContextMenu, true);

		input.addEventListener('input', onInput);
		input.addEventListener('keyup', onInput);

		function onInput(e) {
			if (e.keyCode === 38 || e.keyCode === 40 || e.keyCode === 13 || e.keyCode === 27) return;
			clearTimeout(timer);
			var q = input.value;
			if (q.length < 2) { hideDrop(true); return; }
			timer = setTimeout(function () {
				var url = '/suggest.php?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q)
					+ '&ui=new&lng=' + encodeURIComponent(suggestLng());
				fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin' })
					.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
					.then(renderItems)
					.catch(function () { hideDrop(true); });
			}, 300);
		}

		input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
			var items = dropItems();
			if (!items.length) return;
			if (e.keyCode === 40) {
				sel = Math.min(sel + 1, items.length - 1);
				setActiveItem(items, sel);
				e.preventDefault();
			} else if (e.keyCode === 38) {
				sel = Math.max(sel - 1, 0);
				setActiveItem(items, sel);
				e.preventDefault();
			} else if (e.keyCode === 13 && sel >= 0) {
				e.preventDefault();
				applyItem(items[sel]);
			} else if (e.keyCode === 27) {
				hideDrop(true);
				sel = -1;
			}
		});

		drop.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
			// Only left click opens a suggestion; ignore right/middle.
			if (e.button !== 0) {
				e.preventDefault();
				return;
			}
			var row = e.target.closest('.smn-suggest-row');
			if (!row || !drop.contains(row)) return;
			e.preventDefault();
			applyItem(row);
		});

		input.addEventListener('blur', function () {
			setTimeout(function () { hideDrop(false); }, 200);
		});
		input.addEventListener('focus', function () {
			if (dropItems().length) showDrop();
		});
		window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
			if (drop.style.display === 'block') sizeDrop();
		});
	}

	function initCoverZoom() {
		var covers = document.querySelectorAll('.smn-list-cover');
		for (var i = 0; i < covers.length; i++) {
			(function (cover) {
				var img = cover.querySelector('img');
				var item = cover.closest('.smn-list-item');
				if (!img || !item) return;

				function resetZoom() {
					img.style.transform = '';
					cover.classList.remove('is-zoomed');
					item.classList.remove('is-zoomed');
				}

				function applyZoom() {
					var rect = img.getBoundingClientRect();
					var margin = 16;
					var cx = window.innerWidth / 2;
					var cy = window.innerHeight / 2;
					var imgCx = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
					var imgCy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
					var maxW = window.innerWidth - margin * 2;
					var maxH = window.innerHeight - margin * 2;
					var scale = Math.min(maxW / rect.width, maxH / rect.height);
					var dx = cx - imgCx;
					var dy = cy - imgCy;
					img.style.transform = 'translate(' + dx + 'px, ' + dy + 'px) scale(' + scale + ')';
					cover.classList.add('is-zoomed');
					item.classList.add('is-zoomed');
				}

				cover.addEventListener('mouseenter', applyZoom);
				item.addEventListener('mouseleave', resetZoom);
			})(covers[i]);
		}
	}

	function initNavMore() {
		var nav = document.querySelector('.smn-nav');
		if (!nav) return;

		var primary = nav.querySelector('.smn-nav-primary');
		var wrap = nav.querySelector('.smn-nav-more-wrap');
		var btn = nav.querySelector('.smn-nav-more-toggle');
		var panel = nav.querySelector('.smn-nav-more');
		var overflow = nav.querySelector('.smn-nav-overflow');
		if (!primary || !wrap || !btn || !panel || !overflow) return;

		var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(primary.querySelectorAll('.smn-nav-item'));
		var gap = 14;
		var frame = null;

		function closeMenu() {
			wrap.classList.remove('is-open');
			btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
			panel.hidden = true;
		}

		function openMenu() {
			wrap.classList.add('is-open');
			btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
			panel.hidden = false;
		}

		function measureGap() {
			var styles = window.getComputedStyle(primary);
			var g = parseFloat(styles.columnGap || styles.gap || '14');
			return isNaN(g) ? 14 : g;
		}

		function updateOverflow() {
			items.forEach(function (item) {
				item.classList.remove('is-overflow');
			});
			overflow.innerHTML = '';
			overflow.hidden = true;
			gap = measureGap();

			var available = nav.clientWidth - wrap.offsetWidth - gap;
			if (available < 0) available = 0;

			var used = 0;
			var hideFrom = items.length;

			for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
				var w = items[i].offsetWidth;
				var next = used + (i > 0 ? gap : 0) + w;
				if (next > available) {
					hideFrom = i;
					break;
				}
				used = next;
			}

			// Keep at least one primary item visible when possible.
			if (hideFrom === 0 && items.length > 0 && available > 40) {
				hideFrom = 1;
			}

			for (var j = hideFrom; j < items.length; j++) {
				var src = items[j];
				src.classList.add('is-overflow');
				var clone = src.cloneNode(true);
				clone.classList.remove('is-overflow');
				overflow.appendChild(clone);
			}

			overflow.hidden = overflow.childNodes.length === 0;
		}

		function scheduleUpdate() {
			if (frame) cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
			frame = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
				frame = null;
				updateOverflow();
			});
		}

		btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
			e.stopPropagation();
			if (wrap.classList.contains('is-open')) {
				closeMenu();
			} else {
				openMenu();
			}
		});

		document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
			if (!wrap.contains(e.target)) closeMenu();
		});

		document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
			if (e.key === 'Escape') closeMenu();
		});

		window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleUpdate);
		if (window.ResizeObserver) {
			var ro = new ResizeObserver(scheduleUpdate);
			ro.observe(nav);
			var bar = nav.closest('.smn-header-bar');
			if (bar) ro.observe(bar);
		}

		scheduleUpdate();
	}

	function initTextCollapse(id, options) {
		var el = document.getElementById(id);
		if (!el) return;
		var always = !!(options && options.always);
		var mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 820px)');

		function clearCollapse() {
			el.classList.remove('is-expanded', 'is-collapsible');
			el.removeAttribute('role');
			el.removeAttribute('tabindex');
			el.removeAttribute('aria-expanded');
		}

		function syncCollapsed() {
			if (!always && !mq.matches) {
				clearCollapse();
				return;
			}

			var keepOpen = el.classList.contains('is-expanded');
			el.classList.add('is-collapsible');
			el.classList.remove('is-expanded');

			// Only collapse when content actually overflows the preview height.
			if (el.scrollHeight <= el.clientHeight + 4) {
				clearCollapse();
				return;
			}

			el.setAttribute('role', 'button');
			el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
			if (keepOpen) {
				el.classList.add('is-expanded');
				el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
			} else {
				el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
			}
		}

		function toggle() {
			if (!el.classList.contains('is-collapsible')) return;
			if (!always && !mq.matches) return;
			var open = !el.classList.contains('is-expanded');
			el.classList.toggle('is-expanded', open);
			el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
		}

		el.addEventListener('click', toggle);
		el.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
			if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
				e.preventDefault();
				toggle();
			}
		});
		if (mq.addEventListener) {
			mq.addEventListener('change', syncCollapsed);
		} else if (mq.addListener) {
			mq.addListener(syncCollapsed);
		}
		syncCollapsed();
	}

	/* Mobile: drop sticky header top padding on scroll */
	function initBrandCompact() {
		var header = document.querySelector('.smn-header');
		if (!header) return;
		var mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 820px)');
		var ticking = false;

		function sync() {
			if (!mq.matches) {
				header.classList.remove('is-compact');
				return;
			}
			header.classList.toggle('is-compact', window.scrollY > 8);
		}

		function onScroll() {
			if (ticking) return;
			ticking = true;
			requestAnimationFrame(function () {
				ticking = false;
				sync();
			});
		}

		sync();
		window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
		window.addEventListener('resize', sync);
		if (mq.addEventListener) {
			mq.addEventListener('change', sync);
		} else if (mq.addListener) {
			mq.addListener(sync);
		}
	}

	/* TEMP: pin category aside to sticky breadcrumbs level */
	function initCatAsidePin() {
		var aside = document.querySelector('.smn-article-cat-aside');
		var crumbs = document.getElementById('smn-sticky-breadcrumbs');
		if (!aside || !crumbs) return;

		var header = crumbs.closest('.smn-header');

		function measurePinTop() {
			if (!header) return 0;
			// Breadcrumbs level + a little lower, to clear the header fade.
			var pin = Math.round(crumbs.getBoundingClientRect().top - header.getBoundingClientRect().top) + 60;
			return pin < 0 ? 0 : pin;
		}

		function sync() {
			if (window.getComputedStyle(aside).position !== 'sticky') {
				aside.style.top = '';
				aside.style.maxHeight = '';
				return;
			}
			var pinTop = measurePinTop();
			aside.style.top = pinTop + 'px';
			aside.style.maxHeight = 'calc(100vh - ' + pinTop + 'px - 16px)';
		}

		sync();
		window.addEventListener('resize', sync);
	}

	if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
			initSuggest('input_query_smn', 'suggest-smn');
			initCoverZoom();
			initNavMore();
			initTextCollapse('smn-lead', { always: true });
			initTextCollapse('smn-letter-summary');
			initTextCollapse('smn-press-issue-desc');
			initCatAsidePin();
			initBrandCompact();
		});
	} else {
		initSuggest('input_query_smn', 'suggest-smn');
		initCoverZoom();
		initNavMore();
		initTextCollapse('smn-lead', { always: true });
		initTextCollapse('smn-letter-summary');
		initTextCollapse('smn-press-issue-desc');
		initCatAsidePin();
		initBrandCompact();
	}
})();
</script>

.smn-press-issue-action {

.smn-press-issue-action::after {

.smn-emulator-modal {

}
.smn-press-issue-desc {

}
.smn-press-issue-screen-link {

	text-decoration: none;

}
.smn-press--issue .smn-press-issue-screens {

}

.smn-issue-nav {

	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);

}
.smn-issue-nav a {

}
.smn-issue-nav a::after {

	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;

	height: 2px;

.smn-issue-nav-prev.is-disabled,

.smn-issue-nav-next {

.smn-press-toc-heading {

	font-size: 15px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: -0.01em;

}
.smn-press-issue-screens {

	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 10px;

}
.smn-press-issue-screen {

}
.smn-press-issue-screen:has(.smn-press-issue-screen-img:hover) {

}
.smn-press-issue-screen-img {

.smn-press-issue-screen-img:hover {

}
.smn-press-articles {

	padding: 0;
	list-style: none;
	counter-reset: smn-press-art;
}
.smn-press-article {
	display: flex;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 0.75rem;
	margin: 0;
	padding: 4px 0;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 16px;
	font-weight: 500;
	line-height: 1.45;
	counter-increment: smn-press-art;
}
.smn-press-article::before {
	content: counter(smn-press-art) ".";

	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 16px;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: inherit;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
	text-align: right;
}
.smn-press-article a,
.smn-press-article span {
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
	position: relative;
	padding-bottom: 2px;
	transition: color 0.25s ease;
	min-width: 0;
	overflow-wrap: break-word;
	word-break: normal;
	hyphens: auto;
	-webkit-hyphens: auto;
	-ms-hyphens: auto;
}
.smn-press-article a::after,
.smn-press-article span::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	height: 2px;
	background: var(--smn-accent);
	transform: scaleX(0);
	transform-origin: left;
	transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}
.smn-press-article a:hover::after {

}
.smn-press-article span.is-active {
	color: var(--smn-accent);

}
.smn-press-article span.is-active::after {
	transform: scaleX(1);
}

.smn-ezine-index {
	list-style: none;
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
	overflow: visible;
}
.smn-ezine-index-letter {
	margin: 28px 0 0;
	padding: 0;
	list-style: none;
}
.smn-ezine-index-letter:first-child {
	margin-top: 0;
}
.smn-ezine-index-letter-mark {
	display: block;
	font-family: var(--smn-serif);
	font-size: 1.6rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: -0.02em;
	color: var(--smn-accent);
	padding: 4px 0 8px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-ezine-index-item {
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	position: relative;
	z-index: 1;
	overflow: visible;
}
.smn-ezine-index-item:has(.smn-gallery-img:hover) {
	z-index: 40;
}
.smn-ezine-index > .smn-ezine-index-item:last-child {
	border-bottom: none;
}
/* Last letter group with a single title: letter rule + footer would double. */
.smn-ezine-index > .smn-ezine-index-letter:nth-last-child(2) .smn-ezine-index-letter-mark {
	border-bottom: none;
}
.smn-ezine-index-row {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: nowrap;
	align-items: flex-start;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 12px 20px;
	padding: 10px 0;
	color: inherit;
	text-decoration: none;
	overflow: visible;
}
.smn-ezine-index-text {
	display: flex;
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 8px 24px;
	min-width: 0;
}
.smn-ezine-index-main {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 8px 12px;
	min-width: 0;
}
.smn-ezine-index-splash {
	flex: 0 0 auto;
	line-height: 0;
	position: relative;
	z-index: 1;
	/* Same Spectrum thumb as gallery: 128×96 → scale(2) = 256×192 */
}
.smn-ezine-index-splash .smn-gallery-img {
	/* keep gallery hover zoom; slightly denser in the index */
	width: 64px;
	height: 48px;
	border-width: 3px 4px;
}
.smn-ezine-index-splash .smn-gallery-img:hover {
	/* 64×48 → 256×192 */
	transform: scale(4);
}
.smn-ezine-index-name {
	position: relative;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-weight: 700;
	font-size: 1.05rem;
	letter-spacing: -0.01em;
	color: #000;
	padding-bottom: 2px;
}
.smn-ezine-index-name::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	height: 2px;
	background: var(--smn-accent);
	transform: scaleX(0);
	transform-origin: left;
	transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}
.smn-ezine-index-row:hover .smn-ezine-index-name {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-ezine-index-row:hover .smn-ezine-index-name::after {
	transform: scaleX(1);
}
.smn-ezine-index-count {
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 0.9rem;
	font-weight: 400;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-ezine-index-meta {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 8px 16px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 0.9rem;
	font-weight: 400;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-ezine-index-city {
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 6px;
	line-height: 1.2;
}
.smn-ezine-flag {
	display: block;
	flex: 0 0 auto;
	border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
}
.smn-ezine-index-item.is-offline .smn-ezine-index-name {
	color: var(--smn-muted);
	font-weight: 600;
}
.smn-ezine-index-years {
	white-space: nowrap;
}

@media (max-width: 820px) {
	.smn-frame {
		width: 100%;
		padding: 0 16px 20px;
		box-shadow: none;
	}

	.smn-header {
		margin: 0 -16px;
		padding: 20px 16px 14px;
	}
	.smn-header::after {
		height: 22px;
	}

	.smn-header-bar {
		grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
		grid-template-areas:
			"brand lang"
			"nav nav";
	}
	.smn-brand { grid-area: brand; }
	.smn-brand-name,
	.smn-brand-stripes {
		font-size: 19px;
	}
	.smn-header {
		transition: padding-top 0.2s ease;
	}
	.smn-header.is-compact {
		padding-top: 0;
	}
	.smn-header-bar {
		transition: gap 0.2s ease;
	}
	.smn-header.is-compact .smn-header-bar {
		gap: 8px;
	}
	.smn-lang { grid-area: lang; }
	.smn-nav {
		grid-area: nav;
		justify-content: space-between;
		position: relative;
	}
	.smn-nav-more-wrap {
		position: static;
	}
	.smn-nav-more {
		left: 50%;
		right: auto;
		transform: translateX(-50%);
		min-width: min(220px, calc(100vw - 32px));
		max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
	}
	.smn-hero {
		grid-template-columns: 1fr;
	}
	.smn-hero-visual {
		grid-column: 1;
		grid-row: auto;
		justify-self: start;
		order: -1;
	}
	.smn-list-cover {
		margin: 0 0 10px 12px;
	}
	.smn-list-cover img {
		width: 96px;
		height: auto;
	}
	.smn-list-title {
		font-size: 19px;
	}
	.smn-lead,
	.smn-letter-summary,
	.smn-press-issue-desc {
		position: relative;
		max-height: 7.2em;
		overflow: hidden;
		cursor: pointer;
		-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
	}
	/* Desktop lead collapse uses .is-collapsible; on mobile keep all leads clipped even before JS. */
	.smn-lead.is-collapsible {
		max-height: 7.2em;
	}
	.smn-letter-summary::after,
	.smn-press-issue-desc::after,
	.smn-lead::after {
		content: "";
		position: absolute;
		left: 16px;
		right: 0;
		bottom: 0;
		height: 3.2em;
		pointer-events: none;
		background: linear-gradient(
			180deg,
			rgba(244, 238, 224, 0) 0%,
			var(--smn-paper) 88%
		);
	}
	.smn-lead.is-expanded,
	.smn-letter-summary.is-expanded,
	.smn-press-issue-desc.is-expanded {
		max-height: none;
		cursor: pointer;
	}
	.smn-lead.is-collapsible.is-expanded,
	.smn-letter-summary.is-collapsible.is-expanded,
	.smn-press-issue-desc.is-collapsible.is-expanded {
		overflow-wrap: break-word;
		word-break: normal;
		hyphens: auto;
		-webkit-hyphens: auto;
		-ms-hyphens: auto;
		text-align: justify;
		text-justify: inter-word;
	}
	.smn-lead.is-expanded::after,
	.smn-letter-summary.is-expanded::after,
	.smn-press-issue-desc.is-expanded::after {
		display: none;
	}
	.smn-ezine-index-row {
		align-items: flex-start;
		gap: 10px 14px;
	}
	.smn-ezine-index-text {
		flex-direction: column;
		align-items: flex-start;
		gap: 6px;
	}
	.smn-letter-title {
		font-size: clamp(22px, 5.5vw, 28px);
	}
	.smn-letter-body {
		overflow-wrap: break-word;
		word-break: normal;
		hyphens: auto;
		-webkit-hyphens: auto;
	}
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	*,
	*::before,
	*::after {
		animation: none !important;
		transition: none !important;
	}
}

/* Map / sticky aside: no leftover transform on .smn-main (breaks Leaflet + sticky) */
body.smn-has-map .smn-main,
body.smn-has-cat-aside .smn-main {
	animation: none;
	transform: none;
	opacity: 1;
}

	display: block;
}

	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 200px;

}
.smn-article-cat-aside-sentinel {
	display: none;
}
.smn-article-cat-aside {
	position: sticky;
	/* top set by initCatAsidePin() — slightly below breadcrumbs / header fade */
	top: 0;
	align-self: start;
	width: 100%;
	max-height: calc(100vh - 16px);
	overflow: auto;
	z-index: 40;
	padding: 14px 14px 12px;
	border: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	background: var(--smn-paper);
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-title {
	margin: 0 0 12px;
	font-size: 13px;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.3;
	letter-spacing: 0.02em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
	overflow-wrap: break-word;
	word-break: normal;
	hyphens: auto;
	-webkit-hyphens: auto;
	-ms-hyphens: auto;
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-title a {
	color: inherit;
	text-decoration: none;
	position: relative;
	padding-bottom: 2px;
	transition: color 0.25s ease;
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-title a::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	height: 2px;
	background: var(--smn-accent);
	transform: scaleX(0);
	transform-origin: left;
	transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-title a:hover {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-title a:hover::after {
	transform: scaleX(1);
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-list {
	list-style: none;
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 12px;
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-list a {
	display: block;
	text-decoration: none;
	color: inherit;
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-item-title {
	display: inline-block;
	max-width: 100%;
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 400;
	line-height: 1.35;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
	position: relative;
	padding-bottom: 2px;
	transition: color 0.25s ease;
	overflow-wrap: break-word;
	word-break: normal;
	hyphens: auto;
	-webkit-hyphens: auto;
	-ms-hyphens: auto;
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-item-title::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	height: 2px;
	background: var(--smn-accent);
	transform: scaleX(0);
	transform-origin: left;
	transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-list a:hover .smn-article-cat-aside-item-title {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-list a:hover .smn-article-cat-aside-item-title::after {
	transform: scaleX(1);
}
.smn-article-cat-aside-item-meta {
	display: block;
	margin-top: 3px;
	font-size: 12px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: rgba(60, 55, 50, 0.45);
}
@media (max-width: 820px) {
	body.smn-has-cat-aside .smn-article-layout {
		display: block;
	}
	.smn-article-cat-aside {
		position: static;
		margin-top: 28px;
		max-height: none;
	}
}

/* Article page (ezines-new/{press}/{issue}/{article}) */
.smn-article {

	animation: smn-fade-up 0.55s ease both;
}
.smn-article-header {
	margin: 0;
	flex: 1;
	min-width: 0;
}
.smn-article-title {
	margin: 0 0 10px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: clamp(16px, 4.5vw, 24px);
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	letter-spacing: -0.015em;
	color: #000;
	hyphens: auto;
	-webkit-hyphens: auto;
	overflow-wrap: break-word;
}
.smn-article-meta {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 6px 12px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-article-meta-press,
.smn-article-meta-issue {
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
	position: relative;
	padding-bottom: 2px;
}
.smn-article-meta-press::after,
.smn-article-meta-issue::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	height: 2px;
	background: var(--smn-accent);
	transform: scaleX(0);
	transform-origin: left;
	transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}
.smn-article-meta-press:hover,
.smn-article-meta-issue:hover {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-article-meta-press:hover::after,
.smn-article-meta-issue:hover::after {
	transform: scaleX(1);
}
.smn-article-meta-sep {
	color: var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-article-categories {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 4px 8px;
	margin: 0 0 32px;
	padding: 12px 0;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 13px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-article-categories a {
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
	position: relative;
	padding-bottom: 2px;
	transition: color 0.25s ease;
}
.smn-article-categories a::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	height: 2px;
	background: var(--smn-accent);
	transform: scaleX(0);
	transform-origin: left;
	transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}
.smn-article-categories a:hover {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-article-categories a:hover::after {
	transform: scaleX(1);
}
.smn-article-body {
	margin: 0 0 40px;
	max-width: 100%;
	min-width: 0;
}
.smn-article-text {
	font-family: var(--smn-mono);
	font-size: 15px;
	line-height: 1.4;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	white-space: pre-wrap;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	word-break: break-word;
	max-width: 100%;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
}
.smn-article-text pre {
	margin: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	white-space: pre-wrap;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	word-break: break-word;
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.smn-article-text img {
	max-width: 100%;
	height: auto;
}
.smn-article-text .sprite {
	display: inline;
	line-height: 16px;
}
.smn-article-text .sprite img {
	max-width: none;
	vertical-align: top;
}
.smn-article-blocked {
	padding: 24px;
	background: rgba(164, 30, 0, 0.05);
	border-left: 4px solid var(--smn-accent);
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 16px;
	color: var(--smn-lead);
}
.smn-article-footer {
	margin-top: 40px;
	padding-top: 28px;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-article-related {
	margin-top: 0;
}

/* Article Hero (Header + Cover) */
.smn-article-hero {
	display: flex;
	align-items: flex-start;
	gap: clamp(16px, 4vw, 28px);
	margin-bottom: 28px;
	position: relative;
	overflow: visible;
}
.smn-article-hero:has(.smn-article-cover img:hover) {
	z-index: 50;
}
.smn-article-cover {
	flex: 0 0 auto;
	position: relative;
	z-index: 1;
	line-height: 0;
	overflow: visible;
}
.smn-article-cover:has(img:hover) {
	z-index: 50;
}
.smn-article-cover .smn-gallery-img {
	/* same Spectrum thumb + hover zoom as gallery */
	box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}
.smn-article-cover img:not(.smn-gallery-img) {
	display: block;
	width: clamp(96px, 15vw, 128px);
	height: auto;
	background: #1a1814;
	border-style: solid;
	border-color: #000;
	border-width: 5px 7px;
	border-radius: 2px;
	box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
	box-sizing: content-box;
	transform-origin: center center;
	transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
	will-change: transform;
}
.smn-article-cover img:not(.smn-gallery-img):hover {
	transform: scale(2);
	box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(28, 23, 18, 0.28);
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
	.smn-article-hero {
		flex-direction: column-reverse;
		gap: 16px;
	}
}

/* Timeline (press page) */
.smn-timeline {
	margin: 32px 0 64px;
}
.smn-timeline-dates {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 13px;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
	margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.smn-timeline-rail {
	position: relative;
	height: 1px;
	background-color: var(--smn-line);
	margin: 0 5px;
}
.smn-timeline-dot {
	position: absolute;
	top: 50%;
	width: 6px;
	height: 6px;
	background-color: var(--smn-line);
	border-radius: 50%;
	transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
	z-index: 2;
}
.smn-timeline-dot.is-edge {
	width: 8px;
	height: 8px;
	background-color: var(--smn-accent-soft);
	z-index: 3;
}
.smn-timeline-year {
	position: absolute;
	top: -7px;
	height: 15px;
	border-left: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	opacity: 0.8;
}
.smn-timeline-year-label {
	position: absolute;
	top: 32px;
	left: 50%;
	transform: translateX(-50%);
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 12px;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
	.smn-timeline {
		margin-bottom: 48px;
	}
	.smn-timeline-dates {
		font-size: 13px;
	}
	.smn-timeline-year-label {
		font-size: 11px;
	}
}

/* Catalog: issues-by-year histogram */
.smn-year-chart {
	margin: 12px 0 40px;
	padding: 0;
}
.smn-year-chart-caption {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 6px 16px;
	margin: 0 0 12px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
}
.smn-year-chart-title {
	font-size: 0.95rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: -0.01em;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-year-chart-meta {
	font-size: 0.85rem;
	font-weight: 400;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-year-chart-plot {
	display: flex;
	align-items: flex-end;
	gap: 2px;
	height: 88px;
	padding-bottom: 22px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-year-chart-col {
	position: relative;
	flex: 1 1 0;
	min-width: 0;
	height: 100%;
	display: flex;
	align-items: flex-end;
	justify-content: center;
}
.smn-year-chart-bar {
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	max-width: 14px;
	min-height: 0;
	margin: 0 auto;
	background: var(--smn-accent-soft);
	border-radius: 1px 1px 0 0;
	transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
	transform-origin: bottom center;
}
.smn-year-chart-col.is-peak .smn-year-chart-bar {
	background: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-year-chart-col.is-empty .smn-year-chart-bar {
	background: transparent;
}
.smn-year-chart-col:hover .smn-year-chart-bar {
	background: var(--smn-accent);
	transform: scaleX(1.15);
}
.smn-year-chart-label {
	position: absolute;
	left: 50%;
	bottom: -20px;
	transform: translateX(-50%);
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 10px;
	line-height: 1;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
	white-space: nowrap;
	pointer-events: none;
}

@media (max-width: 820px) {
	.smn-year-chart-plot {
		height: 72px;
		gap: 1px;
		overflow-x: auto;
		overflow-y: hidden;
		padding-bottom: 20px;
		-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
	}
	.smn-year-chart-col {
		flex: 0 0 10px;
	}
	.smn-year-chart-bar {
		max-width: 8px;
	}
	.smn-year-chart-label {
		font-size: 9px;
	}
}

/* ZXNet archive */
.smn-zxnet-topic-title {
	margin: 0 0 8px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-weight: 700;
	font-size: clamp(22px, 3.2vw, 32px);
	line-height: 1.2;
	letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}
.smn-zxnet-years {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 28px;
}
.smn-zxnet-year .smn-list > .smn-list-item:last-child {
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-zxnet-year:last-child .smn-list > .smn-list-item:last-child {
	border-bottom: none;
}
.smn-year-heading {
	margin: 0 0 10px;
	padding-top: 4px;
	scroll-margin-top: 24px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 15px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-year-nav {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 10px 16px;
	margin: 0 0 28px;
	padding: 14px 0;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
}
.smn-year-nav-label {
	font-size: 12px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-year-nav-list {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 8px 14px;
}
.smn-year-nav-link {
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 700;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
}
.smn-year-nav-link:hover {
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-zxnet-topic-echo {
	margin: 0 0 28px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 15px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-zxnet-topic-echo a {
	position: relative;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	text-decoration: none;
	padding-bottom: 2px;
}
.smn-zxnet-topic-echo a::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	height: 2px;
	background: var(--smn-accent);
	transform: scaleX(0);
	transform-origin: left center;
	transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}
.smn-zxnet-topic-echo a:hover {
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-zxnet-topic-echo a:hover::after {
	transform: scaleX(1);
}
.smn-zxnet-messages {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg {
	padding: 22px 0;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
	animation: smn-fade-up 0.55s ease both;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg:first-child {
	padding-top: 0;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg:last-child {

.smn-zxnet-msg:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.05s; }
.smn-zxnet-msg:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.smn-zxnet-msg:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.15s; }
.smn-zxnet-msg:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.smn-zxnet-msg:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.25s; }
.smn-zxnet-msg-meta {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 8px 12px;
	margin: 0 0 14px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-row {
	display: inline-flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 6px;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-label {
	font-size: 11px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.06em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: rgba(60, 55, 50, 0.55);
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-name {
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-sep {
	opacity: 0.45;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-date {
	margin-left: auto;
	font-weight: 400;
	color: rgba(60, 55, 50, 0.72);
	white-space: nowrap;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-body {
	font-family: var(--smn-mono);
	font-size: 14px;
	line-height: 1.45;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
	white-space: pre-wrap;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	word-break: break-word;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-body p {
	margin: 0 0 0.7em;
	white-space: normal;
}
.smn-zxnet-msg-body p:last-child {
	margin-bottom: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 820px) {
	.smn-zxnet-msg-meta {
		font-size: 13px;
	}
	.smn-zxnet-msg-date {
		margin-left: 0;
		width: 100%;
	}
	.smn-zxnet-msg-body {
		font-size: 13px;
	}

/* Books catalog */
.smn-books .smn-list-item:last-child {
	border-bottom: none;
}
.smn-book-card {
	display: block;
	overflow: hidden;
}
.smn-book-cover {
	float: left;
	margin: 0 18px 8px 0;
}
.smn-book-cover img {
	width: 96px;
	height: auto;
	aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
	object-fit: cover;
	background: var(--smn-paper-deep);
	border: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-book-subtitle {
	display: block;
	margin: 0 0 6px;
	font-family: var(--smn-serif);
	font-size: 16px;
	line-height: 1.4;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-book-meta {
	display: block;
	margin: 0 0 10px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 13px;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-book-flags {
	display: inline-flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 6px 10px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 12px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--smn-accent);
}
.smn-book-flag {
	white-space: nowrap;
}

@media (max-width: 820px) {
	.smn-book-cover {
		margin-right: 14px;
	}
	.smn-book-cover img {
		width: 72px;
	}
	.smn-book-subtitle {

	}

	gap: 28px 36px;
	align-items: start;

	gap: 16px;
}
.smn-book-cover-full {
	margin: 0;
}
.smn-book-cover-full img {
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	height: auto;
	background: var(--smn-paper-deep);
	border: 1px solid var(--smn-line);
}
.smn-book-title {
	margin: 0 0 8px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-weight: 700;
	font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
	line-height: 1.15;
	letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}
.smn-book-subtitle-lg {

	font-family: var(--smn-serif);

	font-size: 11px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.06em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: rgba(60, 55, 50, 0.55);

}
.smn-book-fact dd {
	margin: 0;
	font-weight: 600;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-book-section-title {
	margin: 0 0 12px;
	font-family: var(--smn-sans);
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--smn-muted);
}
.smn-book-annotation {
	margin: 0 0 28px;
}
.smn-book-annotation-body {
	font-family: var(--smn-serif);
	font-size: 17px;
	line-height: 1.55;
	color: var(--smn-ink);
}
.smn-book-annotation-body p {
	margin: 0 0 0.8em;
}
.smn-book-annotation-body p:last-child {
	margin-bottom: 0;
}
.smn-book-files {
	margin: 0 0 28px;
}
.smn-book-file-list {

<script>
(function () {
	function initSuggest(inputId, dropId) {
		var input = document.getElementById(inputId);
		var drop = document.getElementById(dropId);
		if (!input || !drop) return;
		var timer = null, sel = -1;

		function suggestLng() {
			var p = location.pathname || '';
			return (p === '/en' || p.indexOf('/en/') === 0 || p.indexOf('/eng/') === 0) ? 'eng' : 'ru';
		}

		function initGoButton() {
			var wrap = input.closest('.smn-search-wrap');
			if (!wrap || wrap.querySelector('.smn-search-go')) return;
			var btn = document.createElement('button');
			btn.type = 'submit';
			btn.className = 'smn-search-go';
			btn.textContent = suggestLng() === 'eng' ? 'detailed search' : 'подробный поиск';
			wrap.appendChild(btn);

			function syncGo() {
				var has = !!String(input.value || '').trim();
				btn.hidden = !has;
				wrap.classList.toggle('has-query', has);
			}

			input.addEventListener('input', syncGo);
			input.addEventListener('change', syncGo);
			input.addEventListener('keyup', syncGo);
			syncGo();
		}

		initGoButton();

		function sizeDrop() {
			var rect = drop.getBoundingClientRect();
			// When hidden, measure from the search wrap bottom.
			var top = rect.top;
			if (!top || drop.style.display === 'none') {
				var wrap = input.closest('.smn-search-wrap') || input;
				top = wrap.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
			}
			var room = Math.floor(window.innerHeight - top - 12);
			if (room < 120) room = 120;
			drop.style.maxHeight = room + 'px';
		}

		function hideDrop(clear) {
			drop.style.display = 'none';
			if (clear) drop.innerHTML = '';
		}

		function showDrop() {
			sizeDrop();
			drop.style.display = 'block';
			sizeDrop();
		}

		function dropItems() {
			return drop.querySelectorAll('.smn-suggest-row');
		}

		function setActiveItem(items, index) {
			for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
				items[i].classList.toggle('active', i === index);
			}
		}

		function itemLabel(item) {
			if (typeof item === 'string') return item;
			return (item && item.label) ? String(item.label) : '';
		}

		function applyItem(row) {
			var url = row.getAttribute('data-url') || '';
			var label = row.getAttribute('data-label') || row.textContent || '';
			hideDrop(true);
			if (url) {
				location.href = url;
				return;
			}
			input.value = label;
			var form = input.closest('form');
			if (form) form.submit();
		}

		function renderItems(data) {
			drop.innerHTML = '';
			sel = -1;
			if (!data || !data.length) {
				var empty = document.createElement('div');
				empty.className = 'smn-suggest-empty';
				empty.textContent = suggestLng() === 'eng'
					? 'Nothing found, try detailed search'
					: 'Ничего не найдено, попробуйте подробный поиск';
				drop.appendChild(empty);
				showDrop();
				return;
			}
			for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
				var item = data[i];
				var label = itemLabel(item);
				if (!label) continue;
				var row = document.createElement('div');
				row.className = 'smn-suggest-row';
				row.setAttribute('data-label', label);
				if (item && item.url) row.setAttribute('data-url', String(item.url));
				if (item && item.type) row.setAttribute('data-type', String(item.type));

				var main = document.createElement('div');
				main.className = 'smn-suggest-label';
				if (item && item.label_html) {
					main.innerHTML = String(item.label_html);
				} else {
					main.textContent = label;
				}
				row.appendChild(main);

				if (item && item.meta) {
					var meta = document.createElement('div');
					meta.className = 'smn-suggest-meta';
					meta.textContent = String(item.meta);
					row.appendChild(meta);
				}
				drop.appendChild(row);
			}
			if (!dropItems().length) {
				var emptyFallback = document.createElement('div');
				emptyFallback.className = 'smn-suggest-empty';
				emptyFallback.textContent = suggestLng() === 'eng'
					? 'Nothing found, try detailed search'
					: 'Ничего не найдено, попробуйте подробный поиск';
				drop.appendChild(emptyFallback);
				showDrop();
				return;
			}
			showDrop();
		}

		function blockSuggestContextMenu(e) {
			e.preventDefault();
			e.stopPropagation();
		}

		// Only block context menu on suggestion rows — not on the input
		// (so Inspect / DevTools via right-click still work).
		drop.addEventListener('contextmenu', blockSuggestContextMenu, true);

		input.addEventListener('input', onInput);
		input.addEventListener('keyup', onInput);

		function onInput(e) {
			if (e.keyCode === 38 || e.keyCode === 40 || e.keyCode === 13 || e.keyCode === 27) return;
			clearTimeout(timer);
			var q = input.value;
			if (q.length < 2) { hideDrop(true); return; }
			timer = setTimeout(function () {
				var url = '/suggest.php?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q)
					+ '&ui=new&lng=' + encodeURIComponent(suggestLng());
				fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin' })
					.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
					.then(renderItems)
					.catch(function () { hideDrop(true); });
			}, 300);
		}

		input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
			var items = dropItems();
			if (!items.length) return;
			if (e.keyCode === 40) {
				sel = Math.min(sel + 1, items.length - 1);
				setActiveItem(items, sel);
				e.preventDefault();
			} else if (e.keyCode === 38) {
				sel = Math.max(sel - 1, 0);
				setActiveItem(items, sel);
				e.preventDefault();
			} else if (e.keyCode === 13 && sel >= 0) {
				e.preventDefault();
				applyItem(items[sel]);
			} else if (e.keyCode === 27) {
				hideDrop(true);
				sel = -1;
			}
		});

		drop.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
			// Only left click opens a suggestion; ignore right/middle.
			if (e.button !== 0) {
				e.preventDefault();
				return;
			}
			var row = e.target.closest('.smn-suggest-row');
			if (!row || !drop.contains(row)) return;
			e.preventDefault();
			applyItem(row);
		});

		input.addEventListener('blur', function () {
			setTimeout(function () { hideDrop(false); }, 200);
		});
		input.addEventListener('focus', function () {
			if (dropItems().length) showDrop();
		});
		window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
			if (drop.style.display === 'block') sizeDrop();
		});
	}

	function initCoverZoom() {
		var covers = document.querySelectorAll('.smn-list-cover');
		for (var i = 0; i < covers.length; i++) {
			(function (cover) {
				var img = cover.querySelector('img');
				var item = cover.closest('.smn-list-item');
				if (!img || !item) return;

				function resetZoom() {
					img.style.transform = '';
					cover.classList.remove('is-zoomed');
					item.classList.remove('is-zoomed');
				}

				function applyZoom() {
					var rect = img.getBoundingClientRect();
					var margin = 16;
					var cx = window.innerWidth / 2;
					var cy = window.innerHeight / 2;
					var imgCx = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
					var imgCy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
					var maxW = window.innerWidth - margin * 2;
					var maxH = window.innerHeight - margin * 2;
					var scale = Math.min(maxW / rect.width, maxH / rect.height);
					var dx = cx - imgCx;
					var dy = cy - imgCy;
					img.style.transform = 'translate(' + dx + 'px, ' + dy + 'px) scale(' + scale + ')';
					cover.classList.add('is-zoomed');
					item.classList.add('is-zoomed');
				}

				cover.addEventListener('mouseenter', applyZoom);
				item.addEventListener('mouseleave', resetZoom);
			})(covers[i]);
		}
	}

	function initNavMore() {
		var nav = document.querySelector('.smn-nav');
		if (!nav) return;

		var primary = nav.querySelector('.smn-nav-primary');
		var wrap = nav.querySelector('.smn-nav-more-wrap');
		var btn = nav.querySelector('.smn-nav-more-toggle');
		var panel = nav.querySelector('.smn-nav-more');
		var overflow = nav.querySelector('.smn-nav-overflow');
		if (!primary || !wrap || !btn || !panel || !overflow) return;

		var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(primary.querySelectorAll('.smn-nav-item'));
		var gap = 14;
		var frame = null;

		function closeMenu() {
			wrap.classList.remove('is-open');
			btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
			panel.hidden = true;
		}

		function openMenu() {
			wrap.classList.add('is-open');
			btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
			panel.hidden = false;
		}

		function measureGap() {
			var styles = window.getComputedStyle(primary);
			var g = parseFloat(styles.columnGap || styles.gap || '14');
			return isNaN(g) ? 14 : g;
		}

		function updateOverflow() {
			items.forEach(function (item) {
				item.classList.remove('is-overflow');
			});
			overflow.innerHTML = '';
			overflow.hidden = true;
			gap = measureGap();

			var available = nav.clientWidth - wrap.offsetWidth - gap;
			if (available < 0) available = 0;

			var used = 0;
			var hideFrom = items.length;

			for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
				var w = items[i].offsetWidth;
				var next = used + (i > 0 ? gap : 0) + w;
				if (next > available) {
					hideFrom = i;
					break;
				}
				used = next;
			}

			// Keep at least one primary item visible when possible.
			if (hideFrom === 0 && items.length > 0 && available > 40) {
				hideFrom = 1;
			}

			for (var j = hideFrom; j < items.length; j++) {
				var src = items[j];
				src.classList.add('is-overflow');
				var clone = src.cloneNode(true);
				clone.classList.remove('is-overflow');
				overflow.appendChild(clone);
			}

			overflow.hidden = overflow.childNodes.length === 0;
		}

		function scheduleUpdate() {
			if (frame) cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
			frame = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
				frame = null;
				updateOverflow();
			});
		}

		btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
			e.stopPropagation();
			if (wrap.classList.contains('is-open')) {
				closeMenu();
			} else {
				openMenu();
			}
		});

		document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
			if (!wrap.contains(e.target)) closeMenu();
		});

		document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
			if (e.key === 'Escape') closeMenu();
		});

		window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleUpdate);
		if (window.ResizeObserver) {
			var ro = new ResizeObserver(scheduleUpdate);
			ro.observe(nav);
			var bar = nav.closest('.smn-header-bar');
			if (bar) ro.observe(bar);
		}

		scheduleUpdate();
	}

	function initTextCollapse(id, options) {
		var el = document.getElementById(id);
		if (!el) return;
		var always = !!(options && options.always);
		var mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 820px)');

		function clearCollapse() {
			el.classList.remove('is-expanded', 'is-collapsible');
			el.removeAttribute('role');
			el.removeAttribute('tabindex');
			el.removeAttribute('aria-expanded');
		}

		function syncCollapsed() {
			if (!always && !mq.matches) {
				clearCollapse();
				return;
			}

			var keepOpen = el.classList.contains('is-expanded');
			el.classList.add('is-collapsible');
			el.classList.remove('is-expanded');

			// Only collapse when content actually overflows the preview height.
			if (el.scrollHeight <= el.clientHeight + 4) {
				clearCollapse();
				return;
			}

			el.setAttribute('role', 'button');
			el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
			if (keepOpen) {
				el.classList.add('is-expanded');
				el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
			} else {
				el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
			}
		}

		function toggle() {
			if (!el.classList.contains('is-collapsible')) return;
			if (!always && !mq.matches) return;
			var open = !el.classList.contains('is-expanded');
			el.classList.toggle('is-expanded', open);
			el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
		}

		el.addEventListener('click', toggle);
		el.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
			if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
				e.preventDefault();
				toggle();
			}
		});
		if (mq.addEventListener) {
			mq.addEventListener('change', syncCollapsed);
		} else if (mq.addListener) {
			mq.addListener(syncCollapsed);
		}
		syncCollapsed();
	}

	/* Mobile: drop sticky header top padding on scroll */
	function initBrandCompact() {
		var header = document.querySelector('.smn-header');
		if (!header) return;
		var mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 820px)');
		var ticking = false;

		function sync() {
			if (!mq.matches) {
				header.classList.remove('is-compact');
				return;
			}
			header.classList.toggle('is-compact', window.scrollY > 8);
		}

		function onScroll() {
			if (ticking) return;
			ticking = true;
			requestAnimationFrame(function () {
				ticking = false;
				sync();
			});
		}

		sync();
		window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
		window.addEventListener('resize', sync);
		if (mq.addEventListener) {
			mq.addEventListener('change', sync);
		} else if (mq.addListener) {
			mq.addListener(sync);
		}
	}

	/* TEMP: pin category aside to sticky breadcrumbs level */
	function initCatAsidePin() {
		var aside = document.querySelector('.smn-article-cat-aside');
		var crumbs = document.getElementById('smn-sticky-breadcrumbs');
		if (!aside || !crumbs) return;

		var header = crumbs.closest('.smn-header');

		function measurePinTop() {
			if (!header) return 0;
			// Breadcrumbs level + a little lower, to clear the header fade.
			var pin = Math.round(crumbs.getBoundingClientRect().top - header.getBoundingClientRect().top) + 60;
			return pin < 0 ? 0 : pin;
		}

		function sync() {
			if (window.getComputedStyle(aside).position !== 'sticky') {
				aside.style.top = '';
				aside.style.maxHeight = '';
				return;
			}
			var pinTop = measurePinTop();
			aside.style.top = pinTop + 'px';
			aside.style.maxHeight = 'calc(100vh - ' + pinTop + 'px - 16px)';
		}

		sync();
		window.addEventListener('resize', sync);
	}

	if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
			initSuggest('input_query_smn', 'suggest-smn');
			initCoverZoom();
			initNavMore();
			initTextCollapse('smn-lead', { always: true });
			initTextCollapse('smn-letter-summary');
			initTextCollapse('smn-press-issue-desc');
			initCatAsidePin();
			initBrandCompact();
		});
	} else {
		initSuggest('input_query_smn', 'suggest-smn');
		initCoverZoom();
		initNavMore();
		initTextCollapse('smn-lead', { always: true });
		initTextCollapse('smn-letter-summary');
		initTextCollapse('smn-press-issue-desc');
		initCatAsidePin();
		initBrandCompact();
	}
})();
</script>
